model.name: Sunday-to-Tuesday market Ridge with QB features, team-scoped injured-reserve starters and an automatic uncertain-QB flag
added_features: ir_starters_diff: home minus away count of non-QB starters on regular injured reserve (designated-to-return not counted), read from each team's latest roster before the Tuesday prediction; a starter played 50% or more of offensive or defensive snaps for that team in any of his last three games, or averaged 50% or more for that team last season if he has not played for it this season; snaps with another team are not counted

qb_uncertain_home and qb_uncertain_away: 1 when the QB the model uses did not finish a close game last week (another passer took a dropback after his last one while the score was within 16 points); the QB numbers are kept, the flag is an extra input; only this automatic rule sets it
market_features: Sunday 11:20 p.m. ET to Tuesday spread movement
Sunday 11:20 p.m. ET to Tuesday total movement

historical.evaluation: 2021-2025 chronological walk-forward; Tuesday US median selects HIGH; graded at best captured US Tuesday quote

interpretation: This is a historical walk-forward research result, not a guarantee of future returns. The uncertain-QB flag rests on about 108 past cases: random flags of the same size matched its HIGH record in 3 of 200 tries, and it pushes the edge toward the home team whichever side is flagged, so treat its effect as unproven. Manual QB scenarios on the card are not part of this benchmark.
